_README: Target zone sizes come from the map sheet §4. That document was not present
in this repo when the pipeline was built, so only the Stonevale figure quoted
in the extraction spec is filled in. Add one entry per zone before Stage 4/5,
or those stages will report the zone as unconfigured and skip its ratio.
Keys are zone ids (lower-case slugs). Fields:
targetSizeMetres  [x, z] compressed world size the design targets
terrainNames      TerrainData m_Name values that map to this zone
worldOriginMetres [minX, minZ] if the terrain is not placed at the world
origin; anchors land outside bounds without it
